title: 2024 Topps Chrome Update Series - X-Fractor Refractor Alex Jacob #USC129 (RC)
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2024 Topps Chrome Update Series trading card features Yuki Matsui, a player for the San Diego Padres in Major League Baseball (MLB). The card is an X-Fractor Refractor parallel/variety, with a card number of USC129. It is an original card manufactured by Topps and is part of the 2024 set. 

The card is a standard size and is in English language. It is a rookie card for Alex Jacob and does not have an autograph. The card is not a vintage or licensed reprint, but is a great addition to any baseball fan's collection.
